find: for (const index of directions) if (isNew(index)) cancel = true;
why: The D-pad is the controller's way out of a capture, and the only one that cannot also be the choice: it is never bindable, while Back's own button is. A capture it cannot cancel leaves a controller-only player able to stop waiting only by binding something.
killedBy: createBindingCapture (issue #754) cancels on a new D-pad press, even with a button pressed on the same frame
the controller layout pane is painted, written and captured for by the page (issue #754) a new D-pad press cancels and stores nothing
